title: Trans interpretations of Oedipus Rex in cinema

commenti.body: I mean, Pasolini’s Oedipus Rex is an Oedipus adaptation by a famously homosexual filmmaker, but it’s not as transformative as Funeral Parade of Roses. I’d still say it’s definitely worth a watch but the queer dimension probably requires further research into Pasolini/watching his other films.
That’s great, thank you! I’ll definitely look into it
